title: Specialization from the closure of a quasi-compact scheme morphism's range
statement: Let j:Z\to S be a quasi-compact morphism of schemes [def-weil-scheme-morphism-properties]. For every point s\in\operatorname{closure}(j(Z)) there exists a point z\in Z such that j(z) specializes to s.
